text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHDOG10, Chihuahua Front Door Knocker

Chihuahuas are known for being lively, and this door knocker really shows off this trait. The attention to detail makes this Chihuahua Premium Size Door Knocker almost seem alive. It is made from solid bronze and has a highlighted patina finish that brings out the exquisite detailing. The Chihuahua Door Knocker comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Features and Specifications of the Premium Solid Bronze Chihuahua Door Knocker:

  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Finish: Solid Bronze with Highlighted Patina
  • Height: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 4-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
